# ciphertrust_azure_vault_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a list of Azure Key Vaults added to the CipherTrust Manager database. Supply a `filters` map to narrow results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List Azure Key Vaults in the CipherTrust Manager database.
# Use ciphertrust_azure_vault_details to discover vaults live from Azure.

# No filter - return all vaults (default limit: 10).
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "all" {}

# Filter by Azure subscription ID.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "by_subscription" {
  filters = {
    subscription_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  }
}

# Key Vaults only, all results sorted by most recently created.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "key_vaults" {
  filters = {
    type  = "vault"
    sort  = "-createdAt"
    limit = "-1"
  }
}

# Managed HSM vaults only.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "managed_hsms" {
  filters = {
    type = "managedHsm"
  }
}

# Look up a specific vault by its CipherTrust Manager resource name.
# The name has the format "vault-name::subscription-id".
# The cckm_vault_name computed attribute on ciphertrust_azure_vault produces this value.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "specific" {
  filters = {
    name = "my-key-vault::xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs matching CipherTrust Manager API query parameters for listing Azure vaults.

> **Note:** Although some filters represent integers, all filter values must be specified as strings. For example, use `"-1"` rather than `-1`.

| filter            | type    | description |
|-------------------|---------|-------------|
| skip              | integer | Index of the first result to return (default: 0). |
| limit             | integer | Maximum number of results to return (default: 10). Use `"-1"` to return all matches. |
| sort              | string  | Fields to sort by. Valid sort fields are `azure_name`, `updatedAt`, and `createdAt`. Prefix with `-` for descending order (for example, `-createdAt`). |
| id                | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource ID. |
| name              | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource name (`azure_name::subscription_id` format). |
| location          | string  | Filter by Azure region. |
| cloud_name        | string  | Filter by cloud name (for example, `AzureCloud`). |
| subscription_id   | string  | Filter by Azure subscription ID. |
| subscription_name | string  | Filter by subscription display name. |
| job_config_id     | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager scheduler job configuration ID. |
| type              | string  | Filter by vault type. Use `vault` for Key Vaults and `managedHsm` for Managed HSM vaults. |

### Read-Only

- `matched` (Number) Total number of vaults matching the given filters.
- `vaults` (Attributes List) List of Azure vaults added to CipherTrust Manager. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Read-Only:

- `azure_vault_id` (String) Azure resource ID of the vault.
- `cloud_name` (String) Cloud name as returned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `connection` (String) Azure connection identifier as stored in CipherTrust Manager.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the vault was added to CipherTrust Manager.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the vault.
- `location` (String) Azure region where the vault is located.
- `name` (String) Azure name of the vault.
- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription ID that contains the vault.
- `subscription_name` (String) Display name of the Azure subscription.
- `synced_at` (String) Date and time the vault was last synced.
- `tags` (Map of String) Azure tags applied to the vault.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the vault was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `uri` (String) CipherTrust Manager unique identifier URI for the vault.
- `vault_properties` (Attributes) Azure vault properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults--vault_properties))
- `vault_type` (String) Azure resource type of the vault.

Read-Only:

- `enabled_for_deployment` (Boolean) Whether Azure Virtual Machines may retrieve certificates stored as secrets.
- `enabled_for_disk_encryption` (Boolean) Whether Azure Disk Encryption may retrieve secrets from the vault.

- `soft_delete_retention_in_days` (Number) Soft delete data retention period in days.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure Active Directory tenant ID for the vault.
- `vault_uri` (String) URI for performing operations on keys and secrets in this vault.
